senses.gloss:
ITA-8.2.7 haritavargaḥ हरितवर्गः
Group of greens
The group of vegetables which should be consumed fresh such as salads, leafy vegetables and certain spices: Zingiber officinale Roscoe (ardraka), Raphanus sativus L. (mulaka), Mentha spicata L.(putiha), Coriandrum sativum L.(dhanyaka) or Allium cepa L. (palandu).

ITA-7.2.3.6 haritālam हरितालम्
Orpiment, yellow arsenic
Arsenic trisulfide (As2S3). Duly processed haritalam is employed as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral pharmaceutical formulations.

ITA-5.41.23 haridramehaḥ हरिद्रमेहः
Polyuria disorder with urine resembling turmeric water
A disorder characterized by passage of acrid urine; passage of turmeric-coloured urine; burning micturition.

ITA-9.6.218 harṣaḥ हर्षः
Removal of foreign body by creating exhilaration
The removal of a loosely impacted foreign body by creating joy, happiness, cheer or exhilaration.
